other_conditions: Must be a native of Rajasthan
Must not have previously availed the benefits of this scheme
Must possess the minimum qualifications required for the selected competitive examination
Parents/guardians' annual income must be less than ₹8 lakh, or parents must be State Government employees receiving a salary up to Level‑11 of the Pay Matrix
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹75,000 for coaching preparation for various competitive examinations.
